g.text: - The Game should load on start.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Players should be able to select a play set (Color of play set).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - A player should be able to make a move.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - A history of each player's moves should be maintained (persisted in memory and disk upon saving).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - The game should switch turns (alternate turns between players).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - A Player should be notified when there is a checkmate.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Players should be notified when the game is over and which player has won the game.
